cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.18)
project(runtime_owner_fixture LANGUAGES CXX)
foreach(server llama-server llama-server-vulkan)
  add_executable(${server} server.cpp)
  target_compile_features(${server} PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
  set_property(TARGET ${server} PROPERTY MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY MultiThreaded)
  target_compile_options(${server} PRIVATE /utf-8)
endforeach()
